subject.title: [Bug]: WebChat + New Session displays default model but inherits parent's model override

question: When a dashboard child session visibly shows or receives an explicit Default selection, should that selection break parent model-override inheritance, or should the inherited effective model remain visible and controllable in the UI?
rationale: Either choice changes compatibility-sensitive persisted session behavior; the source-level repair needs a durable user-facing contract rather than another one-sided resolver adjustment.

options.title: Make explicit Default authoritative
options.body: Persist a child-level default/no-inherit selection so a child displaying Default always routes through the configured effective default.

options.title: Expose inherited selection
options.body: Keep parent inheritance but show the effective inherited model and provide a separate action to reset the child to its configured default.

options.title: Make New Session independent
options.body: Do not attach a parent session for the explicit New Session action, reserving parent linkage for rollover-only flows.

recommendation.title: Make explicit Default authoritative
recommendation.body: Persist a child-level default/no-inherit selection so a child displaying Default always routes through the configured effective default.

likelyOwner.reason: Available feature provenance connects this person to the original inheritance behavior.
